css: .lablec-hullam{height:44px;margin-top:16px;background-color:#2F371E;border-top-left-radius:50% 100%;border-top-right-radius:50% 100%}.lablec-jelenet{padding-top:8px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:34px;padding-left:0px;background-color:#2F371E}.lablec-burok{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;padding-top:0px;padding-right:24px;padding-bottom:0px;padding-left:24px;}.lablec-jelenet-racs{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:28px;row-gap:20px;align-items:center}.lablec-meh{width:120px;height:auto;transform:rotate(-6deg)}.lablec-hivas{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;row-gap:10px;min-width:0px}.lablec-cim{margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;color:#FFF8E7;font-family:Lalezar, "Arial Black", sans-serif;font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,40px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.05}.lablec-szoveg{margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;color:#D3DDBB;font-size:16px}.lablec-letolt{width:100%}.lablec-levelke{display:flex;flex-direction:column;row-gap:8px;min-width:0px;padding-top:18px;padding-right:18px;padding-bottom:18px;padding-left:18px;border-top-style:solid;border-top-width:2px;border-top-color:#000000;border-right-style:solid;border-right-width:2px;border-right-color:#000000;border-bottom-style:solid;border-bottom-width:2px;border-bottom-color:#000000;border-left-style:solid;border-left-width:2px;border-left-color:#000000;border-top-left-radius:16px;border-top-right-radius:4px;border-bottom-right-radius:16px;border-bottom-left-radius:4px;background-color:#FEEEBB;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 0 #000000;color:#000000;transform:rotate(.6deg)}.lablec-levelke-cim{font-family:Lalezar, "Arial Black", sans-serif;font-size:24px;line-height:1.05}.lablec-levelke-szoveg{margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;color:#333333;font-size:14px}.lablec-levelke-urlap{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.lablec-sorok{padding-top:8px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:22px;padding-left:0px;border-top-style:dashed;border-top-width:2px;border-top-color:rgba(211,221,187,.35);background-color:#2F371E}.lablec-sor{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:16px;row-gap:4px;align-items:baseline;padding-top:10px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:10px;padding-left:0px;border-bottom-style:dashed;border-bottom-width:1px;border-bottom-color:rgba(211,221,187,.22)}.lablec-sor-cim{color:#FECF39;font-family:Lalezar, "Arial Black", sans-serif;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1}.lablec-sor-linkek{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:18px;row-gap:2px}.lablec-link{display:inline-block;padding-top:12px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:12px;padding-left:0px;color:#FFF8E7;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none}.lablec-link:hover{color:#FFF8E7;text-decoration:underline}.lablec-also{padding-top:16px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:16px;padding-left:0px;background-color:#232A16;color:#D3DDBB}.lablec-also-racs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;column-gap:22px;row-gap:12px}.lablec-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding-top:6px;padding-right:10px;padding-bottom:6px;padding-left:10px;border-top-left-radius:12px;border-top-right-radius:3px;border-bottom-right-radius:12px;border-bottom-left-radius:3px;background-color:#FFF8E7}.lablec-logo-kep{width:47px;height:30px;max-width:none}.lablec-rovid{display:none;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:16px;row-gap:4px}.lablec-social{display:flex;column-gap:8px}.lablec-social-link{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.lablec-social-link:hover{transform:translate(0px,-3px)}.lablec-social-kep{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain}.lablec-minosites{display:flex;align-items:center;column-gap:12px;color:#D3DDBB;font-size:13px}.lablec-minosites-kep{width:auto;height:46px}.lablec-jogi{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;column-gap:14px;row-gap:4px;margin-left:auto;color:#D3DDBB;font-size:12.5px}.lablec-jogi-link{display:inline-block;padding-top:12px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:12px;padding-left:0px;color:#D3DDBB;font-size:12.5px;text-decoration:underline}.lablec-jogi-link:hover{color:#FFF8E7;text-decoration:underline}@media screen and (max-width: 991px){.lablec-jelenet-racs{grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1fr)}.lablec-meh{width:90px}.lablec-levelke{grid-column-start:span 2;grid-column-end:span 2;transform:none}}@media screen and (max-width: 767px){.lablec-hullam{height:28px}.lablec-jelenet{padding-top:4px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:26px;padding-left:0px;}.lablec-jelenet-racs{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.lablec-hivas{padding-right:84px}.lablec-meh{position:absolute;right:0px;top:4px;width:76px}.lablec-levelke{grid-column-start:auto;grid-column-end:auto}.lablec-sor{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.lablec-jogi{margin-left:0px}}
